newsitem.title: INDIA: India HZL, BHP in zinc/lead survey.
newsitem.headline: India HZL, BHP in zinc/lead survey.

text.p: India's state-run Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) and Australia's BHP plan to conduct an aerial survey for lead and zinc deposits in the northern state of Rajasthan, company officials said on Wednesday.
They said the two firms had signed an agreement under which BHP would do an aero magnetic sensing of deposits in state capital Jaipur and other nearby districts.
"Under this agreement, the feasibility study would be undertaken by the company (BHP) at a cost of $10 million," HZL chairman K.V.K. Seshavataram told Reuters.
Seshavataram said the year-long study would cover a 15,800 sq km area.
BHP would enter into a joint venture with HZL if BHP felt that it was worth exploring the area.
HZL has also signed an agreement with another Australian firm, Pasminco, for a geo-survey of zinc deposits in Kyar region in Ajmer district in Rajasthan.
